items.title: DoorDash-Instacart deal to face DOJ review- Reuters
items.summary: Investing.com-- The U.S. Department of Justice will examine DoorDash’s planned purchase of Instacart, Reuters reported on Monday, citing two sources with knowledge of the situation.

items.title: Exclusive-DOJ to review DoorDash-Instacart merger, sources say
items.summary: Nov 16 (Reuters) - The US Department of Justice will review DoorDash's proposed acquisition of Instacart, two people familiar with the matter told ‌Reuters on Monday. DoorDash said in October it would buy Instacart in a ‌deal valued at about $17 billion, aiming to accelerate its push into the fast-growing US grocery delivery market ​as competition intensifies among app-based platforms.
